verdict.rationale: The evidence only implies this capability. Bindings let Workers reach databases, APIs and storage in a few lines of code without connection management, and Zero Trust controls are built into the network, which suggests in-platform service access without VPC setup. No item states that service-to-service traffic stays off the public internet. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of private Worker-to-Worker or Worker-to-origin connectivity (e.g. service bindings or private tunnels), confirmation that binding traffic never traverses the public internet, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
